flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No weekly/monthly tagging file code to HDB, LTA, TP, or NEA. Nearby: ocmsadminprivateapi AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (only agency types MHA, LTA, TOPPAN), cron-schedules-prod.properties (the monthly report is an exception report), ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts (Warrant Settle Date menu), api-authorization.properties (/v1/warrantofarrest with no controller).
note: Story status is blank in stories.json; assessed from the story text. No selection of tagged IDs with outstanding warrants, no pre-defined criteria (warrant stage, ID type), no weekly or monthly schedule, and no delivery to HDB, LTA, TP, or NEA was found. AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl only knows agency types MHA, LTA, TOPPAN and throws UnsupportedOperationException for others (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-87); LTA in the code is a vehicle-ownership enquiry, not a tagging file, and Toppan is the print vendor (not Traffic Police). The only monthly cron is the Monthly Exception Report (cron-schedules-prod.properties:271-277). The Court module is not built (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727) and the 'Warrant Settle Date' System admin screen (ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/System.ts:163-166) has no backend that could be found. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. The weekly/monthly tagging files to other agencies are not built

steps.step: OCMS selects the IDs tagged by URA with outstanding warrants of arrest
steps.detail: There is no tagging or warrant query or table. The Warrant Description column is blank with the comment 'Court module not ready for MVP1' (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727); /v1/warrantofarrest is only an authorization entry with no controller (ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23). There is no tagging/hitlist entity, repository, service, or screen in the six repos (grep for hitlist, tagging, tagged, SPMS, season parking returns nothing in source). The only leftovers are the commented-out 'Tagged Vehicle' route and menu (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:326-329; ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406; ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/TaggedVehicle.ts:1-12) and a translation label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:167-169).

steps.step: OCMS applies the pre-defined criteria (warrant stage, ID type) to those IDs
steps.detail: There is no tagging criteria configuration or filter. A System admin 'Warrant Settle Date' entry exists in the menu metadata (ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/System.ts:163-166) but no page, API, or parameter table used to select IDs was found; no warrant stage exists because the Court module is not built (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727).

steps.step: OCMS generates a weekly file for the tagged IDs
steps.detail: There is no weekly cron for an agency file. The only weekly cron is the temporary blob cleanup every Monday at 01:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:318), not an agency file; the only monthly cron is the Monthly Exception Report (cron-schedules-prod.properties:271-277).

steps.step: OCMS generates a monthly file for the tagged IDs
steps.detail: The monthly cron on the 1st at 08:30 (cron.monthlyreport) runs the combined exception report, not a tagged-ID file (cron-schedules-prod.properties:271-277). There is no other monthly agency job.

steps.step: OCMS sends the files to other agencies (HDB, LTA, TP, NEA)
steps.detail: createRequestFileContent accepts only MHA, LTA, and the TOPPAN prefix; any other agency type throws UnsupportedOperationException (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-87). There is no SFTP folder or configuration for HDB, NEA, or Traffic Police. LTA in the code is a vehicle-ownership enquiry and Toppan is the letter print vendor, not recipients of a tagging file. Agency SFTP servers cannot be verified from the repo.
